title: Glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glasses, big cute round frames with bright lenses -->
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='42' y='44' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#59e0ff'/>
  <!-- left temple arm -->
  <rect x='8' y='40' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#59e0ff'/>
  <!-- right temple arm -->
  <rect x='82' y='40' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#59e0ff'/>
  <!-- left lens -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='49' r='21' fill='#a8f6ff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='49' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#2ec4e6' stroke-width='6'/>
  <!-- right lens -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='49' r='21' fill='#a8f6ff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='49' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#2ec4e6' stroke-width='6'/>
  <!-- lens highlights -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='41' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='41' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- lens tint -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='4' fill='#7de8ff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='58' r='4' fill='#7de8ff'/>
</svg>
